question: The Paralympics Winter Games– 2022 was hosted by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Beijing 2022 **is the common name for the **2022 Winter Paralympics.**
 
• **Beijing, China** hosted an international winter multi-sport parasports competition from** March 4 to March 13, 2022.**
